literal: Manly effort and mature wisdom, thus of the two, by the continuous action, will grow the family.
translation: A family will rise high through the continuous pursuit of two things: tireless effort and mature wisdom.
modern: விடாமுயற்சி, சிறந்த அறிவு என்று சொல்லப்படும் இரண்டின் தொடர்ச்சியான செயல்பாட்டால் ஒருவனுடைய குடி உயர்வடையும்.
explanation: The couplet identifies the two essential qualities needed to uplift one's family: relentless effort ('ஆள்வினை') and mature wisdom ('ஆன்ற அறிவு'). The phrase 'நீள்வினை' emphasizes that the application of these two traits must be continuous and far-reaching, rather than a temporary burst of energy. When a person combines deep knowledge with sustained hard work, their family or lineage ('குடி') will naturally grow and prosper ('நீளும்').
